description: A brick of grey putty in a waxed sleeve, a coil of lead wire, and a detonator the size of a cigarette that somebody has wrapped in tape and written DO NOT DROP on. The tape is a different colour from the rest of it, which tells you the tape was added later, which tells you something.
name: breaching charge
